# dsh-quicknote

> Capture a note from the DSH composer, keep it out of the way, and manage the list on one page.

## Install

    dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-quicknote

## Verify

    dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -A2 "id: dsh-quicknote"

## Develop

    pnpm install
    pnpm verify

## Read next

- README.md — user guide
- AGENTS.md — repository rules and invariants
- src/host/ — Host half
- src/client/ — browser half
- tests/ — both suites

## Contracts

- Package: dsh-quicknote
- Patch row: `dsh-quicknote`
- Client module id: `dsh-quicknote`
- Storage: `~/.dsh/quicknote/notes.json`
- Routes: `/api/quicknote/notes`, `/create`, `/update`, `/delete`, `/restore`
